dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetric geometric narrowing of the 2D silhouette from the mid-dorsal section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Median mid-grey dorsal tone, characteristic of a transitional sub-adult phase.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker grey clusters distributed across the anterior and mid-dorsal sections.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the base grey canvas and localized mottled regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of multiple, high-contrast dark linear rake marks oriented longitudinally along the posterior dorsal surface.
